snippet.title: Rogue Planet Demo Release Steam Trailer - iMovie Edition (Windows and Mac!!!)
snippet.description:
The demo for Rogue Planet is NOW AVAILABLE TO PLAY ON STEAM!!!!!

Available for Windows and Mac users!!!!!!

I'm proud to announce my long-term project is now available to test out on a major platform! Support me by wish listing and playing the game!!! The final is planned to release in September of this year!

I am a 16 year old indie game dev, and I'd appreciate your support!!! Thank you! 

Stay tuned for more!!!!!
